context: M16 o6. Seoul Star Imports. The Baeks behind the counter. Mrs. Baek holds an envelope.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Mr. Varelas. You own our building. We would like to own it instead.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: Kye is twelve families, one pot. The pot is here. Cash, today.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: You'd buy a building in this city, now? Everyone else is leaving.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Everyone else is leaving. Prices are good.

choices.text: Not yet. Ask me in August.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Sold. To the only optimists in Manhattan. Eleni will draw the papers.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: Good. Now the only landlord we fear is us.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Ask me in August. I have… other paper first.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: August. Fine. We will still be optimists in August. Probably.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Twelve families and a cigar box. More honest than my bank.
